title: Real Talk: What AI and Finance Leaders Say Students Need to Survive the AI Era
author: Stefan Bauschard
summary: Stefan Bauschard synthesizes advice from AI and finance leaders (Sam Altman, Jensen Huang, Jack Ma, Terrence Tao, Larry Fink) about skills students need for the AI era. Key themes include: developing agency and entrepreneurship, learning to work with AI tools, critical thinking and debate, adaptability, and considering non-traditional career paths including skilled trades.
points: Young people must develop their own intuitions and not trust generational assumptions
Single individuals can now operate at scale through AI amplification
Education must teach soft skills, values, independent thinking—not just knowledge
Debate teaches critical thinking, communication, and collaboration
Traditional college pathway fragmenting; skilled trades surge due to AI infrastructure
Recent college graduates face unusual unemployment; alternative pathways gain importance
quotes: If you're not a founder, just join somebody else... There's no other path forward.

The obvious tactical thing is just get really good at using AI tools. When I was graduating as a senior from high school, the obvious tactical thing was get really good at coding, and this is the new version of that.” Archived from Substack on yes by Tim.
